title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Hopkinton grid point, 13–21 April 2026
claims: The archive returns a grid point at 42.21441 N, -71.57895 W, elevation 134 m, for 13–21 April 2026.
Daily maximum temperatures over the nine days range from 9.8°C to 28.5°C, with a median of 19.2°C.
Daily minimum temperatures over the nine days range from -1.6°C to 14.0°C, with a median of 6.9°C.
Six of the nine days recorded at least 1 mm of precipitation and two recorded at least 5 mm.
On 20 April 2026 the grid shows a maximum of 9.8°C, a minimum of 0.3°C, 0.1 mm precipitation and maximum wind of 17.6 km/h.
